facts.value: Obtains Fighter/attribute pointers and tests animation frames. While frames remain it performs no local state-writing work. On expiration it calls ftCommon_8007D60C, which establishes airborne mode, clears ground and vertical animation velocity, exhausts jumps and locks the ECB, with an optional player-system call. It then compares SpecialHi.x64_LANDING_LAG == 0: either signed zero calls ftCo_Fall_Enter; other values, including NaN under ordinary floating-point comparisons, call ftCo_80096900(gobj,1,0,1,1,landing_lag). That helper normally enters FallSpecial and stores the lag, but x2224_b2 redirects before the state change. Subsequent LandingFallSpecial lag application is conditional in the common consumer; this callback implements no lag timer.
facts.rationale: Reconciles the librarian's verified exception finding with exact local work, zero boundary and material preparation effects.

evidence.why: Guard, attribute comparison and outgoing calls.

facts.value: Every invocation selects gravity multiplier 1 if cmd_vars[0] is nonzero, otherwise SpecialHi.x50_AERIAL_GRAVITY. This is a reversible per-call selection, not a latched one-way phase. It calls ftCommon_Fall with multiplier times common gravity and common terminal velocity, then ftCommon_8007D344 with threshold 0, x60_AERIAL_MOBILITY and x58_AERIAL_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY. The fall helper subtracts gravity and clamps only results strictly below negative terminal velocity; equality and unordered NaN comparisons do not trigger clamping. No local validation proves reduced gravity, finite attributes or positive limits, and command-script timing is external.
facts.rationale: Replaces inferred phase progression with verified selector, arithmetic and numerical boundaries.

evidence.why: Per-call selection, multiplication and movement arguments.

facts.value: Tests self_vel.y >= 0. On true, only successful ft_80081D0C triggers ftCommon_AirToGroundStateChange to ftDk_MS_SpecialHi with coll_mf, callback restoration and x54 ground-velocity clamping. On false, ft_CheckGroundAndLedge(gobj,0) is tested first; success performs the same conversion, while failure permits ftCliffCommon_80081298 and conditional ftCliffCommon_80081370. Signed zero takes the first branch and NaN takes the else branch under ordinary floating-point comparisons. Failed applicable predicates request no further local transition, without proving absence of predicate-internal effects. The air-to-ground inline calls ftCommon_8007D7FC then forwards fp->cur_anim_frame, supplied flags, rate 1 and blend 0 to Fighter_ChangeMotionState; complete engine preservation semantics remain external.
facts.rationale: Preserves librarian branch corrections and resolves its source-level air-to-ground frame-argument uncertainty through independent inline inspection.

evidence.why: Grounding preparation and explicit current-frame state-change arguments.
